summary: Frontend-only regression on role-aware onboarding + Profile listino filtering. Provider UI login (provtest@jobby.app) and business token injection (biz-test-token-999) were both used. All 4 requested behaviours PASS: (1) code inspection of provider-onboarding.tsx + onboarding-flow.tsx confirms role param is passed as ?role=business|provider, steps array now includes 'attivita' after 'data', allCats = proximity+standard for business and standard-only for provider, save via api.updateProfile({services}); i18n strings whichActivities/*Sub present in IT and EN. (2) Provider profile shows ONLY the listini matching selected services (profile-listino, profile-driver-listino, profile-art-listino) and DOES NOT show profile-biz-listino, profile-bs-profile, profile-children. (3) Business profile shows profile-biz-listino ('Il mio listino') and NONE of the specialized provider listini (profile-listino/driver/art/bs). (4) Business Activities screen ('Le mie attività') grid renders BOTH proximity (Lavanderia, Calzolaio, Veterinario, Fioreria, Farmacia, …) and standard (Pulizie, Babysitting, Driver, Artigiani, Hospitality, Assistenza, Tecnico, …) chips — all selectable — and Salva button present. Full new-user email/OTP UI flow to 'attivita' step was not executed because Resend domain is not verified (documented), but the code path is verified.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warns: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Non-blocking, accepted per E1 note. Reference: multiple screens (e.g. profile.tsx uses shadow.card).

action_items: None required for the four review items — all pass.
Optional: verify Resend sender domain (yobbyfree.it) in Resend dashboard so real users can complete the email OTP step and actually reach the new 'attivita' step in the UI end-to-end.
Optional cleanup (not blocking): migrate remaining shadow* usages to boxShadow to silence deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: provider-onboarding.tsx correctly derives intendedRole from ?role= param and falls back to user.role — good.
activities.tsx and provider-onboarding.tsx both merge proximity+standard for business and standard-only for provider using api.categories(); consistent.
profile.tsx gates specialized listini strictly on isProviderRole && services.includes(cat) and 'Il mio listino' on isBusiness only; matches spec.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing provtest@jobby.app / test1234 and biz-test-token-999 as documented.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To test business flows in UI: navigate to root, then in DevTools/JS run localStorage.setItem('jobby_session_token', JSON.stringify('biz-test-token-999')) and go to https://<host>/ (NOT reload, must hit index.tsx which routes to /(tabs)). Provider UI login works normally with provtest@jobby.app / test1234. Two 'Accedi' texts exist on landing (tab + submit); use the last one or a stricter selector. Full onboarding-flow → provider-onboarding UI walk is blocked by Resend email OTP (domain not verified) — verify via code inspection or fake auto_verified from backend.
rca_of_issue: Original report claimed onboarding never asked category, provider Profile hid proximity listino and Profile showed all specialized listini regardless of selected services. Fix applied by E1 addresses all three: (a) added 'attivita' step to provider-onboarding with proximity+standard categories for business role and passed ?role= from onboarding-flow so intendedRole is deterministic; (b) profile.tsx now gates 'Il mio listino' on isBusiness (proximity product listino appears for business); (c) specialized listini gated on isProviderRole && services.includes(cat). Verified all three in UI + code.
